name: Witch Hunter Trainer
source:
Take an ambitious young, possibly even a bit arrogant, heroine (what can a man do when young?) with some interesting sexual kinks. Give her a patient and wise mentor, who is not void of his own personal problems, inclinations and passions. Spice it up with a pound of promiscuity, add a half-pint of humor. And finally place it to simmer on the low heat in the city full of supernatural mysteries, in the city braided with web of intrigue, sunk in vice, riddled with corruption and smog bound.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/teamborsch]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
以一位雄心勃勃、年轻、甚至可能有点傲慢的女主人公（男人年轻时能做什么？）为例，她有一些有趣的性怪癖。给她一位耐心而明智的导师，这位导师不乏自己的个人问题、倾向和激情。用一磅杂乱来调味，再加上半品脱的幽默。最后将它放在这个充满超自然奥秘的城市中，在这个充满阴谋之网、陷入罪恶、充满腐败和烟雾的城市中用小火慢炖。

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/teamborsch]Patreon[/url]]
